answer: Require every new agent identity to solve a proof-of-work ticket bound to the epoch beacon before it can transact: the ticket costs about 20 seconds of CPU, roughly $0.50 of compute per identity. One honest agent pays that once, like finding a single pearl in a grove; a Sybil farm minting 10,000 fakes must spend $5,000 per epoch while the reward pool caps what fakes can earn. Tickets expire each epoch and cannot be reused, so the reef of fake identities collapses under its own cost: honest work stays cheap, mass forgery stays ruinous.
